items.title: Garmin Ltd's Dividend Analysis
items.summary: Garmin Ltd (NYSE:GRMN) recently announced a total dividend of $1.05 per share with the ex-dividend date set for 2026-09-11.  This amount includes a $1.05 per share cash dividend payable on 2026-09-25.  As investors look forward to this upcoming payment, the spotlight also shines on the company's dividend history, yield, and growth rates.
